description: This file contains unit tests for health check and validation endpoints of a web API in the DataAssetBackend project, utilizing xUnit framework to verify endpoint responses and behavior.

classes.name: HealthAndValidationEndpointsTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing health and validation API endpoints, using xUnit and a test fixture factory.

methods.name: Root_health_returns_200
methods.description: Tests that the root endpoint '/' returns HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: Healthz_returns_200_even_when_db_is_not_configured
methods.description: Verifies that the '/healthz' endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK even when database is not configured, and checks that the content type is JSON or absent.

methods.name: Validity_check_rejects_empty_value
methods.description: Tests that posting an empty value to '/api/validity-check' returns a response indicating invalidity and includes a reason.

methods.name: Validity_check_accepts_simple_value
methods.description: Tests that posting a valid string to '/api/validity-check' returns a response indicating validity.

methods.name: List_asset_properties_route_is_mapped_and_not_404
methods.description: Checks that the '/api/assets/1/properties' route is mapped and does not return a 404 Not Found.
